senses.gloss: (I)--a son of अनुह्राद and सुर्म्या; disciple of पैऌअ; learnt the ऋग् Veda and taught it to Bodhya and others; rearranged the सम्हितास् into four parts with the help of his four disciples, Bodhya, अग्निमाढक, याज्ञ- valkya and पराशर; arranged three more सम्हितास् and entrusted them to कालायनि, गार्ग्य, and कथा japa, all his pupils. भा. VI. १८. १६; XII. 6. ५४-5; Vi. III. 4. १६-18, २५.
(II)--the father of Jambha and three others. Br. III. 5. ३९.
(III)--a son of प्रह्लाद. M. 6. 9; Vi. I. २१. 1.
(IV)--the son of Virocana; father of four sons. वा. ६७. ७६, ७९. [page२-480+ ३३]
(I)--a son of बाष्कल; author of the वालखिल्य। सम्हिता; imparted it to बालायनि and others. भा. XII. 6. ५९.

(II)--an Angirasa and a मन्त्रकृत्; a श्रुतऋषि; a pupil of पैऌअ in charge of the ऋग् Veda; he arranged it into four सम्हितास्; his disciples were Bodhya, अग्निमाठर, पराशर and याज्ञवल्क्य. Br. II. ३२. १०७; ३३. 4, १३; ३४. २५; M. १९६. १२; वा. ५९. ९८; ६०. २५-26; ६१. 2.

(III)--(भरद्वाज) a pupil of Satyasuja author of three सम्हितास् which were imparted to his dis- ciples आपनाप and others;
1: Br. II. ३४. ३२; ३५. 5.
a शाख Pravartaka.
2: वा. ६०. २९.
